definitions.explanation: Holding a post, seat, or membership on an ongoing, permanent basis rather than temporarily. Used attributively before the name of a position or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常任|じょうにん}⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the permanent conductor of this orchestra.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常任|じょうにん}{理事国|りじこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: Japan is aiming to become a permanent member state.

examples.japanese: {常任|じょうにん}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}している→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: As a member of the standing committee, I attend the weekly meetings.

notes:
Almost always used attributively (before a noun), not as a standalone predicate. It marks a role as ongoing and fixed rather than temporary or rotating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常任|じょうにん}{理事国|りじこく}: permanent member state (of the UN Security Council)
- {常任|じょうにん}⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧: permanent/principal conductor
- {常任|じょうにん}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: standing committee
- {常任|じょうにん}⟦{理事|りじ}→理事：13558_riji⟧: standing director

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常勤|じょうきん}→常勤：16063_joukin⟧: full-time — refers to working hours, not to the permanence of a post
